card.name: Pronouns after verbs and prepositions
card.fires_on: Personal pronouns and possessives such as their, me, you, her, they, and I that follow a verb or preposition and refer to a person or group. Seen in general web prose, quizzes and news.

modes.label: Possessive their
modes.description: The word their before a noun, referring to a group of people.
modes.example: download and retain copies of the Material on<< their>> personal systems in digital form

modes.label: Object pronoun
modes.description: Me, you or her used as the object of a verb or preposition.
modes.example: I have over 600 villages under<< me>>, how can I undertake a two-year

modes.label: Subject pronoun
modes.description: They or I starting a clause after a noun or a comma.
modes.example: significantly altering the way<< they>> live.

card.plain: It marks pronouns like their, her or me that point back to a person already mentioned.
